body:
## Pull request overview This PR updates Base UI’s `RadioGroup` form integration to more closely match native “successful control” submission semantics by using the live set of registered radio inputs rather than relying on a single representative hidden input. **Changes:** - Register each `Radio.Root` hidden input in the shared Field validation registry so validation/focus/value projection can resolve against live inputs. - Update `RadioGroup` form-value projection to omit selections that are effectively disabled (e.g. via `
`) or associated with a different form. - Add browser-only tests that compare Base UI submission results to native `FormData` behavior for enabled/fieldset-disabled/external-form cases and for post-enable validation/focus recovery. ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 5 out of 5 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.
Show a summary per file | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | packages/react/src/radio/root/RadioRoot.tsx | Registers each radio’s hidden input with Field validation and removes the old control ref registration path. | | packages/react/src/radio-group/RadioGroupContext.ts | Removes the no-longer-used `registerControlRef` from the RadioGroup context type. | | packages/react/src/radio-group/RadioGroup.tsx | Switches control resolution to Field validation’s live inputs and updates `getFormValue` to follow native submission eligibility. | | packages/react/src/radio-group/RadioGroup.test.tsx | Adds browser-mode tests asserting parity with native `FormData` and verifying validation/focus recovery after enabling a fieldset. | | packages/react/src/field/root/useFieldValidation.ts | Updates comments to reflect multi-input fields including radio groups and clarifies representative-input behavior. |
